recipes.machineType: Forge of Gods · install END upgrade

conditions.prerequisiteUpgrade: EE must be active, with its own prerequisite tree and material/progress costs satisfied.
conditions.scope: These materials and 12 internal credits are paid for installing END, not per emitted shard. No Graviton Shard or casing is manufactured by the fake upgrade-cost display.
conditions.machine: Existing formed and progressed Forge of Gods, relevant structure/modules and fuel infrastructure.

steps: Progress Forge of Gods and install prerequisites through EE.
Submit END extra material costs and spend 12 internal Graviton credits to install END.
Use the unlocked physical shard ejection option.

recipes.machineType: Forge of Gods · eject earned Graviton Shard

inputs.role: END upgrade installed; reusable machine state

conditions.requires: END active; Graviton Shard Ejection enabled; exactly one output bus; at least one available unspent internal Graviton credit.
conditions.actualBatch: Implementation attempts to eject all currently available credits; normalized here to one physical gem per one ejected credit.
conditions.progressGeneration: available = sum_i[p_i*(p_i+1)/2] - shardsSpent; p_i capped at7 before inversion. Source determineGravitonShardAmount L928.
milestoneTracks: Charge: total power consumed by Godforge modules.
Conversion: total recipes processed by Godforge modules.
Catalyst: total Forge of Gods fuel consumed.
conditions.inversionCondition: All four milestone tracks at least7 unlock inversion; later progress may exceed7.
conditions.accounting: There is no fixed item/fluid/EU recipe per Graviton Shard. Milestone progress requires previous machine operation, fuel, processing and power; exact marginal cost depends on saved Godforge state and chosen work.

steps: Earn internal Graviton credits through the four Godforge milestone tracks.
Activate the END upgrade and enable Graviton Shard Ejection.
With one output bus available, eject credits as physical Graviton Shard gems; each emitted gem spends one credit.

rejectedRecipeExplanation: Godforge Upgrades source_id is a .fake() display of END material costs/unlocks, not a machine recipe that produces one casing plus one Graviton Shard. Tool-only crafting record228750 is invalid for this material tree and must also be excluded.

milestoneReference.formulaNote: Reference summarizes source logarithmic milestones. Java integer division/floating precision and saved counters govern exact threshold behavior; use implementation for exact edge cases.

limitations: Upgrade prerequisite tree through EE, Forge construction, fuel selection and module recipe workloads are explicit operational prerequisites, not expanded into one universal per-shard bill.
Unspent credits are state, not a freely renewable inventory item. Ejection must not be treated as unlimited generation merely because no ordinary item input is consumed per shard.
